newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano to open 1st U.K. outlet in June.
newsitem.headline: Giordano to open 1st U.K. outlet in June.

text.p: Casual wear maker and retailer Giordano International Ltd will invade the European market by opening its first outlet in London in mid-June, Giordano's chairman Peter Lau said on Friday.
"We signed a franchise agreement in the U.K. in early May and we expect the first shop to be opened in mid-June," Lau told reporters in a news conference.
The chairman said Giordano had decided to focus on marketing its developed product line of T-shirt and jeans in this new market.
"From the U.K., we will gradually extend to other European countries," he added.

But Terry Ng, executive director responsible for business development, said Giordano would first focus on the U.K. market and it was unlikely to open outlets in other European countries in the next three to six months.
The Hong Kong-based retailer expected to open about 60 shops in the United Kingdom in the first three years and about 100 shops in five years, he added.
Lau also said Giordano's growth this year would come from two sources.
First was the diversification in Giordano's matured markets such as Hong Kong, Singapore and Taiwan, and seond was the focus of its developed product lines in its new markets.
The company has opened new outlets for women's clothes called Giordano Ladies as the first stop moved towards diversification.
"We opened 11 (Giordano Ladies) in Taiwan, seven in Singapore and three in Hong Kong," Lau said.
The group currently has more than 500 retail and distribution outlets in 13 territories in Asia, Australia and the Middle East.
Giordano earlier reported a 4.4 percent rise of annual net profits of HK$261.23 million for calendar 1996 on turnover of HK$3.52 billion.
